digest.component_or_area: fsck and doctor CLI commands, tracker maintenance
propositions: fsck must detect and classify dirty-tree wedges into three categories: tracked deletions restorable from HEAD, untracked regenerable leftovers, and orphaned tmp-event files
doctor --repair must heal dirty-tree wedges non-destructively by restoring tracked deletions, quarantining leftovers, and converging the store under two separate write-lock windows
repair actions must record a backup ref before mutating files and leave class-3 tmp-event files untouched while preserving all bytes
fsck JSON output must register three distinct tracker-dirty kinds with per-class counts and paths for end-to-end structured reporting
doctor --repair must refuse mutation if no backup ref can be created and must release the write lock before invoking reconverge
the file-mutating repair window must respect the non-reentrant write-lock contract and never delete files (restore or move to quarantine only)
